'''Kenchin jiru''' (けんちん汁, 巻繊汁 ''kenchinjiru''), also spelled '''kenchin-jiru''', and sometimes referred to simply as '''kenchin''', is a Japanese [[vegetable soup]] prepared using [[root vegetable]]s and [[tofu]].<ref name="Shurtleff Aoyagi 1975"/><ref name="Gordinier 2015"/> It is a popular dish in Japan and is prepared in various manners using myriad ingredients. It has been stated that the dish originated several centuries ago from [[Kenchō-ji]], a temple, and it has also been suggested that the dish has its roots in [[shippoku]] cuisine.
